name: Giorgi Metskhvarishvili
title: Engineering Leader · Software & Solution Architect
summary: Engineering leader and software architect with 10+ years of experience building large-scale distributed systems in gaming, banking, government and iGaming. I architected a mobile esports platform from scratch to 40+ microservices, 2.6M+ users and 99.98% availability, broke a bank's vendor monolith into in-house microservices handling 1–1.5M transactions a day, and led a ~60-person government IT organization through the modernization of 26+ legacy applications. Hands-on in C#/.NET and cloud-native infrastructure, with deep expertise in DDD, CQRS, event-driven architecture, payments, security and fraud prevention.
availability: Open to new opportunities · remote or relocation · full-time or B2B

experience.note: Architected the platform from scratch and launched it in 8 months: 40+ microservices, 2.6M+ users, 3.4M+ payout transactions, ~2,900 automated tournaments a day, 99.98% availability and ~50 production deployments a week. Built the fraud-prevention system (43,000+ accounts blocked or suspended).

Led ~15 engineers across five product teams. Migrated Sports services to AWS (EKS, RDS, ElastiCache, Amazon MQ), cutting their infrastructure costs by 30% and making their API responses 35% faster; archived 300+ repositories and decommissioned 50+ obsolete services.

experience.role: Associate Partner, Software Development Chapter Lead

Designed and single-handedly built the backend of a raffle platform for the 16th energy drink brand: 10M+ unique product QR codes, millions of participants and an automated daily draw engine.
